report_name: Chipping Norton Local Cycling and Walking Infrastructure Plan
how_pct_was_used: The Propensity to Cycle Tool (PCT) was used to identify and classify cycle desire lines (Primary, Secondary, and Local) based on 2011 Census journey to work data to help create the cycle network.
other_tools_developed: Route Selection Tool (RST) and Walking Route Audit Tool (WRAT)
specific_evidence_of_impact: The LCWIP identifies 170 specific infrastructure improvement schemes, including junction redesigns, new crossings, and cycle parking, which will guide future funding bids and developer contributions to improve active travel and air quality.
pct_usage_quote: The Propensity to Cycle Tool (PCT) (using 2011 Census journey to work data) and local knowledge were used to create this network.
